directive: Revise angle 0 in place, preserving the novel shrinking-cumulant branchwise-frontier kernel, but repair every well-posedness defect identified by the reviewer. Define the statistical experiment and L_G/L_N on an explicit joint law of training data, training-realized fitted nuisances, and independent evaluation data (or state a fully conditional-on-training formulation consistently), so the suprema range over projected evaluation experiments rather than ambiguous law-and-fit triples. Replace the cubic score by the full split-sample estimated Appell/cumulant polynomial: estimate and account for the residual first and second cumulants as well as the third cumulant (equivalently, explicitly center and studentize on an independent fold), and rederive both the inversion denominator and the B_n remainder bound for that actual construction. Make the logarithmic conclusion exact: state the currently supportable lower boundary using a separately defined d_n^- if the Gaussian logarithmic loss remains, and move removal of that loss to a labelled OEQ with a concrete success criterion; do not use phrases such as "if unavoidable" in theorem conclusions. Define every logarithmic factor at epsilon_g,n = 0 (for example by a piecewise convention consistent with the Gaussian benchmark) and re-check the representative regimes. Delete the definitional absolute-cross-modulus symmetry proposition; retain only a precisely defined nontrivial scalarized-risk consequence if one is genuinely used. Synchronize all theorem statements, assumptions, definitions, tldr, justification, and related-work prose with these repairs, and keep the fuzzy-Hermite construction honestly open rather than claiming its converse before it is built.

Revise angle 0 once more, preserving the repaired field-tier upper-frontier target. Remove procedure-specific learner performance from membership in the law class: define the statistical model by primitive properties of the data law, and state the nuisance-radius condition either as existence of fits attaining the supplied radii with the selected fits supplied explicitly as inputs to the construction, or as a conditional-on-realized-fits experiment outside the law class. Keep the risk suprema and training/evaluation probability space consistent with that choice throughout. Also make the advertised 1-alpha union honesty operational by specifying an explicit simultaneous error allocation and joint high-probability event for the DML fallback interval, the centered/studentized Appell inversion, cumulant estimation, and branch selection; do not hide this calibration inside an unspecified K_alpha. Synchronize definitions, assumptions, theorem hypotheses, construction, and prose. Do not promote the fuzzy-Hermite OEQ to a theorem unless a valid same-experiment two-prior construction is actually supplied.

Repair the remaining median-of-means well-posedness defect without changing the field-tier target. Impose an explicit finite-sample condition such as n at least the required ceiling for every block count used at beta = alpha/16 (or equivalently define each block count as min{n, ceil(8 log(2/beta))}); in either case specify a partition into nonempty blocks and use the same convention in def:mom-calibration, def:estimated-appell-score, lem:calibration-event, and thm:adaptive-upper-frontier. Prefer a clean eventual-n theorem if that is all the asymptotic rate claim needs. Also display a finite-n branch-selection error bound in terms of delta_n, s_n, and the MOM radius, with an explicit universal-constant quantifier, so the simultaneous coverage and expected-length calculation are checkable rather than implicit. Synchronize the representative regimes and all construction prose. Preserve the fuzzy-Hermite lower frontier as an OEQ unless it is actually proved.

Repair the two new attribution issues while preserving the accepted conditional supplied-fit scope and field-tier kernel. Retag ass:outcome-noise-variance as a novel auxiliary nondegeneracy assumption, not a standard JMS envelope condition; justify its applicability briefly and isolate exactly where the conditional lower variance is needed in the Gaussian expected-length converse. Correct the ZhengBonviniGuo2025PerturbedDML comparator: cite Theorem 2 for filtered-union coverage and interval length, and describe Theorem 3 only as the oracle-proximity/existence ingredient. Add an explicit non-overlap comparison with the repository paper stat_sa_plm_cumulant_converse: that work treats fixed-separation spectral/estimation constructions and leaves the local-to-Gaussian branchwise union-honest expected-length problem unresolved, whereas this proposal's proved contribution is the conditional supplied-fit shrinking-separation upper frontier. Do not overclaim a matching Pareto frontier while the Rademacher-partition fuzzy-Hermite pair remains open. Synchronize the assumption table, comparator promise table, related work, novelty justification, tldr, and theorem prose.
